what: Sanctioned-theater flows — estimates, never members (PG01 §6.2a, §6.3.4). Each row: source, asOf, detected, marked estimated, and a declared settlement layer with a basis. 'unknown' is a legitimate value and expected to be the commonest; the map renders it as unknown. Hand-dated; the pipeline never writes here.

rows.measure: Urals discount to Brent in India

settlement.basis: Russia–India crude trade has run in rupees/dirhams/yuan since 2022 sanctions; the discount is the price of the non-dollar barrel.

rows.measure: Barrels redirected from Indian cutbacks to China

settlement.basis: Russia–China crude is yuan-settled by both parties' statements since 2023.

rows.measure: Russian diesel licensed into the US — promised volumes
rows.units: million tonnes total (300k t immediately · 500k t in November · 1M t thereafter), per Trump's post; estimated
rows.source: Trump post 2026-10-09 via The National / CNBC; Russia has not confirmed supply; refinery capacity uncertain after the strike campaign

settlement.basis: Sale into the US market under an OFAC general license — dollar-invoiced by construction — with Russia's sovereign accounts (central bank, NWF, MinFin) barred from receiving debits at US institutions. The dollar clears; the state is cut out of the clearing.
